rows.grounds: compound of phala and ikṣu, object of offering
fused form of ca, anyat, and ca indicating additional items

items.question: What additional sweet offerings must be given repeatedly to the goddess?
premises: Sweet fruit and sugarcane are specified as offerings.
Other sweet items are also included.
The giving is to be done repeatedly to her.
items.inference: The worshipper should repeatedly offer sweet fruits, sugarcane, and other sweet substances to the goddess.
items.plain_english: One should give her sweet fruits, sugarcane, and other sweet things again and again.
